execution_implementation.provenance_note: HKU-MARS official FAST_LIO remains ROS1/catkin; Humble execution uses this explicit ROS2 port and must freeze its commit in each run.

evidence: The declared Franklif1/Fast_LIO2_ROS2 execution source publishes state_point.pos/state_point.rot as camera_init->body.
Its IMU initialization estimates the gravity vector but does not rotate the estimator state to a gravity-aligned world, leaving the initial body attitude gauge near identity.
trajectory_contract.runtime_warning: The first green-house smoke observed odom->sensor instead of the declared execution source's camera_init->body. Treat this as a runtime provenance/frame-label mismatch until the installed package commit is identified.

native_map.note: The selected ROS2 port accumulates/publishes its native map when publish.map_en is enabled; this adds runtime overhead and is therefore opt-in and must be recorded.

benchmark_notes: Classical direct IESKF scan-to-map baseline. The ROS2 port names its extrinsic state Lidar_*_wrt_IMU, matching benchmark LIDAR_TO_IMU. The declared port keeps the estimator world initially body-aligned rather than applying FAST-LIVO2's explicit gravity-alignment step. Runtime frame labels must match the frozen execution provenance before formal comparison.
